## BigQuery

Yoyu Li’s course uses public temperature data to look at how temperatures changed over several decades. In BigQuery, grouping observations by year and using `AVG()` gives one value per year for a trend chart. Joining observations to country information makes it possible to compare countries. I’d check that the join returns one match per observation so duplicate rows don’t skew the averages. To calculate change, a subquery can find each country’s average for two periods, then the outer query subtracts the earlier average from the later one.

## Looker Studio

A line chart shows the temperature trend by year. A column chart compares selected countries over the same period. A geo chart uses country as the dimension and temperature change as the metric, so the color shows how much the temperature changed. The map title and legend should specify the periods and units.
